name: EL Dorado Goldfields Limited
summary: EL Dorado Goldfields Limited operates as a mineral exploration company. The company primarily explores for rutile, ilmenite, zircon, monazite, gold, titanium, and other rare earth elements. It holds interests in the Rio Grande project located in the state of Rio Grande do Su, Brazil; the Oko North and Oko South gold projects situated in Cuyuni Mining District, Guyana; the Paraiba project located Paraíba, Brazil; and the Alcobaça project situated in Bahia State, Brazil. EL Dorado Goldfields Limited was formerly known as Liberty Metals Ltd and changed its name to EL Dorado Goldfields Limited in October 2026. Liberty Metals Ltd was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.
